subject.title: perf: cache Claude CLI version probes by executable fingerprint

question: Should this PR require production-path runtime evidence, or should the standalone algorithm demonstration receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: ClawSweeper policy does not treat a recreated standalone implementation as after-fix production proof, while the contributor has explicitly requested a maintainer decision about whether the existing evidence is sufficient.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal or log output from compiled code invoking the real `ProviderVersionDetector`, showing cache reuse and fingerprint invalidation without a live OAuth account.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused tests and standalone demonstration as sufficient for this low-risk performance optimization.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal or log output from compiled code invoking the real `ProviderVersionDetector`, showing cache reuse and fingerprint invalidation without a live OAuth account.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority to grant a proof override or uphold the production-proof requirement.
